Sandbox_TGSRRRanchMortality.Enabled_tool: When disabled, ranch spawning uses vanilla's day 60 mortality start, day 190 female deadline, and day 250 male deadline.
Sandbox_TGSRRRanchMortality.RollStartDay: Used only when custom ranch mortality is enabled. Ranch animals spawned on or before this elapsed world day are always alive. Vanilla uses day 60.
Sandbox_TGSRRRanchMortality.FemaleDeathD: Used only when custom ranch mortality is enabled. Female ranch animals use vanilla's increasing mortality roll and are guaranteed dead by this day. Use -1 to disable female mortality.
Sandbox_TGSRRRanchMortality.MaleDeathDay: Used only when custom ranch mortality is enabled. Male ranch animals use vanilla's increasing mortality roll and are guaranteed dead by this day. Use -1 to disable male mortality.
Sandbox_TGSRRAlarmDecay.Enabled_tooltip: Replaces vanilla's six alarm battery-decay ranges with the exact minimum and maximum below.
Sandbox_TGSRRAlarmDecay.MinimumDay_toolt: Minimum number of days after the power shuts off before a building's alarm battery stops working.
Sandbox_TGSRRAlarmDecay.MaximumDay_toolt: Maximum number of days after the power shuts off before a building's alarm battery stops working. Use 730 for two years.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Enabled_tooltip: Replaces vanilla helicopter recurrence with this schedule. The vanilla helicopter event itself is retained.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year1Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar month numbers only, for example 7,1 for July and January. Leave empty for no custom events in this challenge year.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year2Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar month numbers only, for example 7,1 for July and January. Leave empty for no custom events.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year3Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar month numbers only, for example 7,11,3. Leave empty for no custom events.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year4Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar month numbers only. Leave empty for no custom events.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year5Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar month numbers only. Leave empty for no custom events.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year6Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar month numbers only. Leave empty for no custom events.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year7Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar month numbers only. Leave empty for no custom events.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year8Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar month numbers only. Leave empty for no custom events.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year9Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar month numbers only. Leave empty for no custom events.
